name: Izumino Mitsuki
source:
"It's written as 'selfish,' but read as 'my own pace.'"

A "half" ghost member of the literature club. She's very laid back and has an elusive personality. Though she never shows up in the club room, she always turns in her manuscripts and
secretly helps out with miscellaneous tasks.

Kazuya describes her behavior as being "kind of like a youkai." 

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara09.html]official website[/url]]
